verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents the pieces an agent needs: webhooks that fire when transcription completes or when team meetings are processed, a Zapier integration driven by those webhooks, a GraphQL transcript API, and an MCP server whose tools can take actions. It also generates action items after every meeting. However, no evidence shows a native push to Linear, Jira or Asana, and none shows that the API returns action items as a structured field, so the agent or Zapier must do the tracker filing itself. Missing for 10: native project-tracker integrations or automations, documented action-items field in the API, hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end action-item-to-tracker workflow.
